# Zuzana Hošková — Not an Agency

> Zuzana Hošková is an independent fractional CMO working across strategic marketing, public relations, and communications, with 20 years of experience in culture, media, and the nonprofit sector.

The website is available in Czech and English. The homepage language switch changes the page language.

## Main pages

- [Homepage](https://notanagency.cz/): Services, biography, approach, client references, and contact information.
- [Case studies](https://notanagency.cz/case-studies.html): Selected marketing and PR projects, including DEKKADANCERS and Má vlast.

## Services

- Fractional CMO and strategic marketing leadership
- Marketing strategy, audits, and process setup
- Marketing consulting, mentoring, and training
- PR strategy, media relations, press materials, and interview preparation
- Personal branding and PR for experts, founders, and leaders
- Creative direction for marketing campaigns
- Partnerships connecting brands with culture

## Focus and experience

Zuzana works with culture, media, nonprofits, smaller brands, and personal brands. Her background includes journalism and communications leadership for Jatka78, DEKKADANCERS, Fotograf Zone, the Prague Pride festival, and the Czech Chamber of Architects.

## Selected work

- Má vlast: PR for a co-produced, multi-genre project with 250+ media outputs.
- DEKKADANCERS: Marketing and PR for theatre and dance projects.
